describe.description: The creature is a chimera shown in right profile walking to the right, with the overall body, fur, and posture of a brown bear but bearing the dorsal armor and forehead horn of a large beetle. Its body is covered in thick shaggy brown fur that is lighter on the muzzle and underbelly and darker on the lower legs, with a robust bear-like build on four legs. Covering its entire back from the base of the neck to the rump is a large, highly glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shell with a smooth domed section over the shoulders and a larger ridged oval section over the back. A single large curved glossy horn with two small inner points rises from the center of its forehead. The head is bear-like with a black nose and small dark eyes, and a small furry tail stub is visible at the rear beneath the shell.

describe.description: A stocky four-legged creature with dense shaggy brown bear fur, head, ears, legs, paws and short tail walking in profile to the right. Its back is covered from the shoulders to the rump by a large glossy dark reddish-brown beetle shell with a rounded shield over the shoulders and a long ribbed wing-case over the back, edged in black with a serrated lower margin. A single long glossy dark reddish-brown curved horn with blunt prongs, like that of a rhinoceros beetle, projects upward and forward from the center of its forehead.
